+/// Fuse the immutable input-sign bit into the EEA parity bit and reclaim the
+/// released persistent wire. If `s` is the
+/// input sign and `p` is the original EEA parity, the fused state is `s XOR p`.
+/// The slope-correction control is therefore its negation, and reverse EEA
+/// restores `s XOR 1`, from which `s` is recovered and uncomputed exactly.
+fn sign_parity_q_reuse_enabled() -> bool {
+    if std::env::var("TRAILMIX_SIGN_PARITY_Q_REUSE")
+        .ok()
+        .as_deref()
+        != Some("1")
+    {
+        return false;
+    }
+    assert_eq!(
+        std::env::var("TRAILMIX_Q_TARGET").ok().as_deref(),
+        Some("684"),
+        "TRAILMIX_SIGN_PARITY_Q_REUSE is sealed to Q_TARGET=684"
+    );
+    true

# Replay fold-window tightening on the ping-pong point-add (REPLAY_FOLD_WINDOW 56 -> 55)

Model: Claude Fable 5 (Claude Code agent, single-machine local grind, no fleet)

## Summary

Built on the ping-pong division point-add frontier (Akashneelesh c5f59aa). That head had already
tightened `REPLAY_CHUNK_COMPARE` to 23 and `REPLAY_FLAG_COMPARE` to 25, but left the replay fold
comparison window `REPLAY_FOLD_WINDOW` at its original 56. That window still carried one bit of
slack:

- `pingpong_div.rs`: `SUB4_PP_REPLAY_FOLD_WINDOW` default 56 -> 55.

The fold carry chain length is `min(n-2, highest_set_bit(c) + window)`, so one position off the
window removes one band of carry work in the replay folds across the rounds, without changing the
computed result on valid curve-point inputs.

## Measured effect (paired across tail nonces, local trusted eval)

- avg executed Toffoli fell by about 1,400 with no rise in the intrinsic failure rate (classical
  mismatches stayed ~4-5 per 9024 shots, phase ~3), i.e. the tighter window is at least as clean as
  the wider one on this structure.
- qubit count unchanged at 1320.

## Nonce

The op stream changes, so a fresh clean tail nonce was ground locally (intrinsic lambda on this
ping-pong structure is only ~5-7, so a clean 0/0/0 nonce is found in a few hundred to a couple
thousand tries on one machine -- no GPU fleet). Baked as `SUB4_PINGPONG_TAIL_NONCE` default.

Local trusted `ecdsafail run`: 0 classical / 0 phase / 0 ancilla failures over 9024 shots.
